images.view: Close three-quarter view at eye level from slightly behind and to the left of the prototype, with the whole prototype centred in the frame and filling most of it.
images.subject: A sleek far-future high-tech laser emitter with a seamless streamlined armoured casing and illuminated light strips, mounted on a compact pedestal.
images.detail: It fires one thick blazing beam of red light with a white-hot core, which recedes in perspective across the hall and leaves the frame on the right side, with no target in sight.

images.view: Low three-quarter view at eye level, close to the prototype, with the whole prototype centred in the frame and filling most of it.
images.subject: A sleek far-future high-tech laser emitter with a seamless streamlined armoured casing and illuminated light strips, mounted on a compact pedestal.
images.detail: It fires one thick blazing beam of red light with a white-hot core, which shoots away from the camera in strong perspective and exits the frame on the right edge, with no target in sight.
